b1.focus: Present tense: introductions, family, town, daily routine, work, shopping, appearance, belongings

b2.focus: Past tenses and the future: childhood, studies and work, the town, celebrations, housing, trips

b3.focus: Languages in everyday life, restaurants, mishaps, culture and sport, weather, big purchases, studies, health

intro.subtitle: Sounds, spelling, grammar, verbs and exceptions

x-temps-verbals.subtitle: All the tenses on one timeline: when to use which, the forms, and how they differ from English

x-nombres-calendari.subtitle: Numbers, telling the time, parts of the day, days of the week, months and seasons

b1-01.topic: Meeting people: name and spelling your surname, where you’re from, your mother tongue, where you live, your phone number; introducing someone else
grammar: ser, dir-se, viure: soc / em dic / visc — es diu, és de, viu a
the personal article: Soc la Maria, en Daniel
countries with an article: del Marroc, de l'Equador, del Perú
possessives with the article: el meu telèfon, la meva llengua, el teu, el seu
gender of nationalities: anglès / anglesa, marroquí / marroquina
b1-01.vocab: Countries, nationalities, languages; the alphabet; numbers 0–20 (digits 0–9 for phone numbers)
b1-01.extra: Spelling out loud: «be alta», «ela geminada», «ce trencada», «essa doble»; phone numbers digit by digit
b1-01.mission: Introduce yourself to a Catalan speaker (name, where you’re from, mother tongue, where you live) and ask them to spell their surname for you

b1-02.topic: Family: who's who by age and relationship, relatives' names, where they live and how old they are
grammar: demonstratives: aquest, aquesta, aquests, aquestes — Aquesta és la meva filla (“This is my daughter”)
plural possessives and “our, your”: els meus avis, la nostra filla
de + the personal article: el fill d'en Martí, la tia de la Marina
viure and tenir in every person: On viu la teva mare? Té 46 anys (age with “have”, not “be”)
també / tampoc: Jo també. Jo tampoc. (“Me too. Me neither.”)
b1-02.vocab: Ages and stages (nadó, nen, noi, home, dona gran) and relatives (pare, germà, avi, oncle, cosí, nebot, net, sogre, cunyat, marit, dona, parella)
b1-02.extra: Numbers up to 99: vint-i-u, trenta-dos, quaranta-sis; Catalan first names and two surnames
b1-02.mission: Show a classmate a family photo and tell them about three relatives: who they are, their name, where they live and how old they are

b1-03.topic: Where I live: address (town, street, number, floor), what's near my home, services in town
grammar: present tense of regular verbs
hi ha / és / està: Hi ha una farmàcia (“There's a chemist's”). On és el mercat?
prepositions of place: a prop de, davant de, al costat de
ordinals for floor and flat: tercer segona
b1-03.vocab: The city, streets, shops and public buildings
b1-03.extra: How to read Barcelona addresses: c/, pl., 3r 2a
b1-03.mission: Spell out your address in Catalan and describe what's near your home in five sentences

b1-04.topic: Days and times: what we do on which day, mealtimes, telling the time, opening hours, months, seasons and weather
grammar: telling the time with quarts: un quart de deu; A quina hora…?
days of the week with the article: el dilluns (“on Monday”) / els dilluns (“on Mondays”)
reflexive verbs: llevar-se, dutxar-se
prepositions of time: a l'hivern, al matí, a la nit
b1-04.vocab: Àpats: esmorzar, dinar, berenar, sopar; days of the week, months, seasons, weather: fa fred, fa sol, plou
b1-04.extra: The Catalan «quarts» system for telling the time — nothing like it in English
b1-04.mission: Find out the opening hours of a museum or library in Catalan and arrange to meet someone, giving the time with quarts

b1-05.topic: Everyday activities and free time: what, who with, on which days and at what time, how often
grammar: present tense: -ar, -er/-re, -ir and -ir verbs with -eix-
frequency adverbs: sempre, sovint, de vegades, mai
amb qui?: amb el meu germà, sol / sola
anar / venir
b1-05.vocab: Free time, study, chores, expressions of frequency
b1-05.extra: anar and venir: “I’m coming!” is «Ja vaig!» — venir is only for movement towards the speaker
b1-05.mission: Describe your weekly timetable in Catalan

b1-06.topic: Work: jobs, where I work and as what, what I do at work, field and type of job
grammar: treballar de, fer de
feminine job titles: metge / metgessa
fer: faig, fas, fa
b1-06.mission: Explain in Catalan what you do at work

b1-07.topic: Food and shops: signs, quantities and prices, informal tu and polite vostè in shops, food tastes and Catalan dishes
grammar: en with quantities: en vull dos (“I want two of them”)
quant / quanta / quants / quantes
un quilo de, mig quilo, una dotzena
tu and vostè: Què vol? Alguna cosa més?
agradar: m'agrada / m'agraden (“it pleases me”)
b1-07.vocab: Groceries, shops (fleca, carnisseria, peixateria), shopping phrases
b1-07.extra: Barcelona markets and Catalan dishes: pa amb tomàquet, escudella, crema catalana
b1-07.mission: Do your shopping at a market entirely in Catalan

b1-08.topic: Appearance, personality and clothes: describing a person and comparing two people
grammar: adjective agreement: -a, -ssa, invariable adjectives
comparisons: més… que, menys… que, tan… com
ser and estar for qualities
portar: porta texans i jersei (“he's wearing jeans and a jumper”)
b1-08.vocab: Appearance, personality traits, clothes for the season and the occasion
b1-08.mission: Describe a friend’s looks and personality so well that someone could recognise them

b1-09.topic: Belongings: whose it is, what it's like (colour, size, shape, material) and what it's for; money; classroom objects
grammar: De qui és? — És meu. És de la Maria. (“Whose is it? — It's mine. It's Maria's.”)
colour agreement: vermell / vermella, blau / blava
servir per a + infinitive (“to be for …ing”)
plurals: clau → claus, butxaca → butxaques
b1-09.vocab: Everyday objects, colours, materials, money (euros, cèntims), classroom objects
b1-09.mission: List in Catalan everything in your backpack

grammar: agradar: m’agrada / m’agraden (“it pleases me”)
voler + infinitive
module review
b1-10.extra: Winter festivals: Castanyada, Nadal, Tió, Sant Esteve
b1-10.mission: Invite someone to a celebration in a written message in Catalan

b2-01.topic: Childhood and youth: who I lived with, what I was like then and now, what I played; the people close to me
grammar: the imperfet: parlava, vivia, era (“used to / was …ing”)
de petit, quan era jove
comparing: abans… ara (“before… now”)
b2-01.extra: Imperfet of ser / estar / fer / veure
b2-01.mission: Write a paragraph about where and with whom you lived as a child

b2-02.topic: Studies and work: the education system, my education, working conditions, household chores, what you're doing right now
grammar: estar + gerund: Què estàs fent? (“What are you doing?”)
haver de + infinitive (“have to”)
past and present: abans treballava de…, ara treballo de…
b2-02.vocab: Education (ESO, batxillerat, FP, universitat), working conditions (horari, sou, contracte), household chores
b2-02.extra: The Catalan education system; false friends in work vocabulary
b2-02.mission: Read a job advert in Catalan and retell it

b2-03.topic: Daily routines of children, adults and older people; what people do at work; buying at the counter: the queue, the product, the price
grammar: reflexive verbs: where the pronoun goes
abans de / després de + infinitive
en at the counter: me'n posa mig quilo (“give me half a kilo of it”)
b2-03.extra: «Qui és l'últim?» — how to join the queue and order at the counter
b2-03.mission: Describe a typical day of someone in your family, and buy something at a counter, joining the queue in Catalan

b2-04.topic: The town then and now: services near home, transport, asking the way, getting a service sorted (a library card)
grammar: imperfet and present: abans hi havia…, ara hi ha… (“there used to be…, now there is…”)
directions: agafa el metro, gira a la dreta
vostè / vostès and polite requests: voldria, podria
the pronoun hi: hi vaig en bus (“I go there by bus”)
b2-04.vocab: Neighbourhood, transport, library, ajuntament, documents, forms
b2-04.extra: The Biblioteques de Barcelona network and the free library card
b2-04.mission: Get a library card using only Catalan

b2-05.topic: Celebrations and presents: choosing one, where to buy it, describing what you want in a shop; inviting and answering an invitation
grammar: the futur: regalaré
indirect object: li, els; doubling: li… a en Daniel
politely declining: Em sap greu, no podré venir (“I'm sorry, I won't be able to come”)
b2-05.vocab: Celebrations, presents, shops, in-store announcements, congratulations
b2-05.extra: The personal article en / na / l’ before names
b2-05.mission: Invite a friend to a celebration, and politely turn down someone else's invitation — in Catalan

grammar: comparisons: més… que, tan… com, millor, pitjor
hi ha / no hi ha cap
b2-06.vocab: Home, furniture, appliances, lloguer, pis, àtic
b2-06.mission: Describe your flat as if you were letting it

grammar: the passat perifràstic: vaig arribar (“I arrived”, not “I’m going to arrive”)
dates and years
fa + time: fa tres anys (“three years ago”)
b2-07.extra: How to say years: dos mil vint-i-sis
b2-07.mission: Tell a Catalan acquaintance how you moved to Barcelona

b2-08.topic: Trips: talking about a trip, comparing holiday places, nature parks, accommodation, ticket machines
grammar: the passat perifràstic: vam anar, vam dormir (“we went, we slept”)
transport and duration: en tren, trigar dues hores (“to take two hours”)
the pronoun hi: hi vam anar en cotxe
b2-08.vocab: Transport, accommodation (alberg, càmping, casa rural), nature, tickets
b2-08.extra: Catalan nature parks: Montseny, Aigüestortes, Cap de Creus
b2-08.mission: Plan a trip to a nature park in Catalan: transport, how many days, where to stay, what to see

b2-09.topic: How people change: appearance, personality and habits then and now; an important person in your life
grammar: imperfet and present compared
soler + infinitive (“usually”, “used to”)
ja no, encara
b2-09.vocab: Habits, looks, personality in the past
b2-09.extra: Passat perifràstic or imperfet: which one when
b2-09.mission: Compare yourself five years ago and now

b2-10.topic: Review of Bàsic 2, first health topics
grammar: the perfet: s’ha trencat
review of the past tenses
b2-10.vocab: Parts of the body, injuries, wishes
b2-10.mission: Write a get-well message to a friend who is ill

b3-01.topic: Languages in everyday life: who speaks which languages, how people learn them, how often I speak Catalan
grammar: guessing: deu ser de…, deu parlar… (“he must be from…, she must speak…”)
pronoms febles: putting it all together
tu and vostè
b3-01.vocab: Languages, language learning, neighbours and conversation
b3-01.extra: How to keep the conversation in Catalan when people switch to Spanish or English
b3-01.mission: For a week, speak only Catalan with your neighbours and shop assistants

b3-02.topic: Restaurants and cooking: choosing a restaurant, the menu, booking a table, apologising; recipes and Catalan dishes
grammar: the imperative: talla, afegeix, poseu
politeness: Voldria reservar una taula. Perdoni.
en and quantities
b3-02.extra: Catalan cuisine: pa amb tomàquet, escalivada, crema catalana
b3-02.mission: Write down your favourite recipe in Catalan

b3-03.topic: Mishaps: what has just happened, minor injuries and incidents, short phone calls, voicemail, the news
grammar: perfet and passat perifràstic
irregular past participles
b3-03.mission: Leave a voice message in Catalan: what has happened and why you can't come

b3-04.topic: Culture and free time: books, cultural news, traditional festivals, sport; suggesting and recommending
grammar: suggesting: Per què no anem…? Què et sembla si…? (“Why don't we…? How about…?”)
preferences: prefereixo, m'estimo més (“I'd rather”)
advice: hauries de + infinitive (“you should”)
b3-04.mission: Recommend a book, a festival or a sport to a classmate and explain why

grammar: the future: irregular forms
conditions: si + present, future
b3-05.mission: Read the weather forecast on 3Cat and retell it

b3-06.topic: Buying a car: which vehicle suits whom, comparing models, credit, choosing a colour
grammar: giving an opinion: crec que, em sembla que
comparisons and superlatives: el més…
b3-06.vocab: Cars and other vehicles, features, colours, credit
b3-06.mission: Compare two things you are choosing between and justify your choice

b3-07.topic: Education, plans for the future, wishes
grammar: continuar + gerund
pensar / tenir ganes de + infinitive
m’agradaria
b3-07.extra: After A2: Elemental, Intermedi, CPNL certificates
b3-07.mission: Talk about your plans for learning Catalan

b3-08.topic: Health and feelings: illnesses and symptoms, medicines and home remedies, telling someone off for being careless, how you feel
grammar: tenir mal de (“to have a … ache”)
advice and reproaches: hauries de, no hauries de, cal que
pronouns with health verbs
b3-08.vocab: Symptoms, medicines, CAP, farmàcia, feelings and moods
b3-08.extra: The health system: CAP, targeta sanitària
b3-08.mission: Prepare the phrases you need for a visit to the doctor in Catalan

grammar: review of the tenses
review of the pronoms febles
b3-09.extra: Summer festivals: Sant Joan, revetlla, coca
b3-09.mission: Write a letter to your teacher about how the course went
